description: Get the user's account balances (USD Account, EUR Account, CHF Account, CAD Account, MXN Account, USD Earnings, EUR Earnings, USD Smart Earnings, EUR Smart Earnings), optionally filtered by currency. CHF, CAD, and MXN rows only appear for users in their staged rollouts (gated by ENABLE_CHFAU, ENABLE_CANADA, and ENABLE_MXNB). Balances are fetched live from the blockchain by default. If blockchain queries fail, returns the latest database snapshot with a notice. Check the 'source' field: 'live' means real-time blockchain data, 'snapshot' means historical data from the last periodic sync. Includes sparkline trend data from recent snapshots and current APY rates for earnings accounts.

currency.description: Filter by currency (USD, EUR, CHF, CAD, or MXN)

name: get_balance
